name: session-rail
description: A rail of your session's prompts in a pane beside the transcript: hover to read one in full, with when it was sent, and click to jump to it. The engine's own message list is the primary history source, with the transcript adding ids, turn details and older prompts.

colorScheme.title: Color scheme
colorScheme.description: auto follows the /config theme: a built-in light theme gets the light palette, a dark theme the dark one, and a custom theme is read from its definition's base. dark or light forces one, for a custom theme the rail cannot read.

cardTheme.title: Card theme
cardTheme.description: The color family of the hover card and of the row or bar under the pointer. Each family carries a dark and a light panel; Color scheme decides which side is drawn, so a theme change under /config switches both together. warm-taupe is the default; the rest range from quiet neutrals (warm-charcoal, slate) through warm accents (sienna, burgundy, ochre) to clearly hued panels (teal, indigo, olive, plum, mauve). A raw Hover card background overrides the family.

accentFollowsCardTheme.title: Accent follows card theme
accentFollowsCardTheme.description: Whether the accent — the prompt being read, the compacted divider, the started and resumed lines, the hover card's stats line and the marquee seam — follows the Card theme. On by default: mauve, teal, indigo, plum and slate draw their own accent, while warm-taupe, warm-charcoal, sienna, burgundy, olive and ochre keep Claude's orange so the accent stays distinct from the green, yellow and red status colors. Off fixes Claude's orange (#D77757 in dark themes, #9E4422 in light ones) for every family.

classicHooks.title: Classic hooks
classicHooks.description: Register the classic.SessionStart and classic.Stop hooks, which name the transcript exactly. Off silences Claude Code's notes about the security default skipping them on a machine with managed settings or in a Team or Enterprise organization, where they never ran anyway; elsewhere, the rail then finds the transcript by session id under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude, which misses a transcript Claude Code keeps somewhere else.

expandOnHover.title: Expand on hover
expandOnHover.description: Hovering a prompt opens its card: the whole prompt when its row cuts it, and when it was sent, how long its turn took, how it ended and the files it edited. Off leaves the rail as it is, with no card; a prompt the rail cuts is then read only in part.

scrollOnHover.title: Scroll on hover
scrollOnHover.description: With Expand on hover on, a prompt the rail cuts scrolls in place on one line instead of taking the card's lines: in the pane the hovered row scrolls and keeps only the sent time and the turn's details on a line beneath, and the hover cards a narrow pane hands to the band scroll the prompt the same way. Off, the pane's card wraps the whole prompt.

cardBackground.title: Hover card background
cardBackground.description: The background of a hover card, and of the row under the pointer: a theme key (e.g. inactive) or a raw color (a name such as red, or hex). In the pane the hovered row's ellipsis is covered by this same color, so the card reads as continuing its sentence. Empty follows the Card theme's variant for the active Color scheme (warm-taupe: #3A3531 in dark themes, #E8E1D8 in light ones).

cardText.title: Hover card text
cardText.description: The text color of a hover card's prompt, its scrollbar thumb and padding, and — when no Hover card stats text is set — its stats line: a theme key or a raw color. Applying it also sets the hovered row. Pick one that reads against Hover card background. Empty follows the color scheme's body text (#D4D0CB in dark themes, #35312D in light ones) for the chrome, while the card's prompt takes the scheme's bright highlight (#FFFFFF in dark themes, #000000 in light ones); both are checked against the panel and fall back to whichever white or black a custom background can carry. The stats line instead draws the card theme's accent tint.

cardStatsText.title: Hover card stats text
cardStatsText.description: The color of a pane card's stats line, which reads as a sentence: when the prompt was sent, how long its turn ran, how it ended and what it changed. The line is pinned at the card's foot, so it stays in view while the prompt above it scrolls. Empty follows the card theme's accent tint (#E6A182 in dark themes, #9E4422 in light ones), adjusted for the panel when a custom Hover card background cannot carry it; when Hover card text is set, that color takes its place. A theme key or a raw color overrides it.
